title: Kernelized Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.01062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering provides a simple, training-free mechanism for controlling attributes of generative models such as sentiment, style, and helpfulness. However, standard approaches such as Difference-in-Means apply a single input-independent steering vector across all activations, limiting expressivity and ignoring the local geometry of the activation space. We propose Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unifying framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. KAS formulates steering as an optimization problem expressed purely via kernel evaluations, yielding an implicit, activation-dependent steering score without constructing explicit feature maps. Unlike DiM, KAS induces locally adaptive steering: each activation is modified according to its relative position with respect to source and target reference sets, producing a nonlinear steering field over the representation space. translated_abstract: 激活引导提供了一种简单的、无需训练的机制，用于控制生成模型的属性，例如情感、风格和有用性。然而，诸如均值差法等标准方法在所有激活上应用单一且与输入无关的引导向量，这限制了表达能力，并忽略了激活空间的局部几何结构。我们提出了核化激活引导，这是一个将激活引导提升到再生核希尔伯特空间的统一框架。KAS将引导表述为一个纯粹通过核函数评估来表达的优化问题，从而在无需构建显式特征映射的情况下，产生隐式的、依赖于激活的引导分数。与DiM不同，KAS实现了局部自适应的引导：每个激活根据其相对于源参考集和目标参考集的相对位置进行修改，在表示空间上形成一个非线性的引导场。重要的是，DiM是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出核化激活引导（KAS）框架，将激活引导提升到再生核希尔伯特空间，通过核函数评估实现依赖激活位置的局部自适应非线性引导，克服了传统均值差法单一引导向量的局限性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unified framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, achieving locally adaptive, nonlinear, activation-dependent steering through kernel evaluations, thereby overcoming the limitations of the single input-independent steering vector used in Difference-in-Means.
